notes:
Shortcut fix: Control + Option works again when macOS keeps Secure Input on after you unlock your Mac. Before, talk2me paused the shortcut until you logged out, and lock and unlock did not help. Pasting works then too.
When the shortcut cannot run, the card on Home turns red, and holding Control + Option opens talk2me where it says why.
This is version 2.17 (build 2112). A shortcut with another key (for example Control + Option + D) still pauses while Secure Input is on, and Home tells you to switch to Control + Option.
